title: How to Cancel YouTube Premium — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel YouTube Premium in 60 seconds. Stop the $13.99/mo charge and go back to the free ad-supported tier. Web and mobile steps included.
intro: YouTube Premium cancellation is straightforward — done in under a minute. You'll go back to the ad-supported free tier but keep all your uploads, playlists, and subscriptions.

steps.title: Go to your YouTube memberships page
steps.text: Navigate to youtube.com/paid_memberships in your browser. Or in the YouTube app: tap your profile picture → Purchases and memberships → Manage memberships.

steps.title: Click "Manage membership" next to YouTube Premium
steps.text: Find your YouTube Premium membership in the list and click "Manage membership" or the gear icon next to it.

steps.title: Click "Deactivate" or "Cancel membership"
steps.text: Select "Deactivate" and then choose "Cancel subscription". YouTube may show you what you'll lose (ad-free, background play, YouTube Music).
steps.tip: If you mostly use YouTube Music, consider switching to YouTube Music Premium ($10.99/mo) instead of full Premium ($13.99/mo).

steps.title: Confirm cancellation
steps.text: Click "Continue to cancel" and then "Yes, cancel" on the final confirmation. Your Premium features remain active until the end of your billing period.
steps.tip: Any downloaded videos for offline viewing will become unavailable after your Premium expires.

warnings: If you subscribed through Apple App Store (iOS), you must cancel through Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions.
YouTube Music Premium is included with YouTube Premium. Canceling Premium cancels Music access too.
If you're on a Family plan, only the family manager can cancel. All family members lose Premium features.
Background playback and picture-in-picture on mobile will stop working on the free tier.

faqs.q: Will I see ads again after canceling YouTube Premium?
faqs.a: Yes. Once your Premium expires, you'll see ads before and during videos, lose background playback, and lose offline downloads. Your content and subscriptions are unchanged.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund for YouTube Premium?
faqs.a: Google does not offer refunds for YouTube Premium. Your access continues through the end of your billing period. For billing errors, contact Google support.

faqs.q: What happens to my YouTube Music library?
faqs.a: Your library, playlists, and liked songs are preserved. You can still use YouTube Music free with ads and shuffle-only playback on mobile.

faqs.q: Can I cancel YouTube Premium but keep YouTube Music?
faqs.a: Yes. After canceling Premium, you can subscribe to YouTube Music Premium separately ($10.99/mo) for ad-free music without the full YouTube Premium features.

refund.details: Google does not offer refunds for YouTube Premium subscriptions. Your Premium benefits continue until the end of your current billing cycle.

retentionTactics: YouTube may offer a discounted rate (often 1-3 months at a reduced price).
They'll remind you of features you'll lose: ad-free, background play, offline downloads, YouTube Music.
